title: OpenOSINTShieldState
description: Schema for OSINT identity isolation state, data-broker opt-out tracking, metadata noise payload verification, and transport fingerprint neutralization (OPEN-OSINT-SHIELD-v1.0 / LMTI-v1.0).

identity_id.description: SHA-256 hash of the isolated identity node.

property_decoupled.description: True if all real estate assets are registered to anonymous legal entities.

corporate_decoupled.description: True if direct ownership markers are severed from public corporate registries.

phone_decoupled.description: True if primary phone maps to non-PSTN non-indexed switchboards.

address_decoupled.description: True if primary physical residence is obfuscated via forwarders.

exposure_score.description: Calculated exposure ratio (0.0 = completely isolated, 1.0 = fully exposed).

ja3_ja4_randomization_active.description: True if TLS Client Hello cipher suite and extension ordering are randomized.

tcp_window_equalization_active.description: True if outbound TCP window sizes and MSS options match standardized baselines.

http2_frame_padding_active.description: True if HTTP/2 stream headers and settings frames are padded to defeat OSINT profiling.
